mechanism: Lisdexamfetamine may increase CNS stimulation and seizure risk in patients on valproic acid (an anticonvulsant), while valproic acid may increase amphetamine levels through protein binding displacement and potential CYP450 inhibition.
action: Monitor closely for increased stimulant side effects, behavioral changes, and seizure breakthrough; consider alternative ADHD medication if valproic acid therapy is essential; ensure therapeutic drug monitoring of valproic acid levels.
